# Pull Requests Are Not Accepted

Singulisp does not currently review or merge pull requests. We do not have the capacity to review changes responsibly and maintain them afterward.

Please report bugs and propose features through GitHub Issues rather than by opening a pull request. The project itself will implement any changes it accepts.

This pull request may be closed without review. This policy does not restrict forks or independent modifications. See the repository's `CONTRIBUTING.md` for details.
